ns2:section.sectionText: Addresses the IT management issues for general managers and IT professionals related to (1) strategic implications of IT in the modern business, (2) impact of IT on productivity, (3) how IT changes the organization, (4) how the organization may leverage its use of IT to create value, and (5) how IT may be used to improve the supply-chain and overall capabilities to better meet customer needs. This course is open to students pursuing the Graduate Minor in Information Technology.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
